# er605_setting (Resource)

A singleton router form (DHCP server, time, DNS, ...). Only the keys given in config are managed and drift-checked; delete just forgets it (the router keeps the last values).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) jsonencode({...}) of the fields to set, same names/values the read form returns.
- `endpoint` (String) e.g. /admin/dhcps?form=setting

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
